1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Move a card to its end state by calling the commands that own that move.
3	
4	The driver never edits a card's status itself. Closing runs close_work, giving
5	up runs escalate_work, and the machine retrospective only fills the slots and
6	the facts — what was learned is left for whoever merges the run, because a run
7	cannot judge from inside whether its own behavior should bind future work.
8	"""
9	
10	from __future__ import annotations
11	
12	import os
13	import re
14	import shlex
15	import subprocess
16	import sys
17	from collections.abc import Callable
18	from pathlib import Path
19	
20	STAGE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
21	for import_dir in (
22	    STAGE_ROOT / "hooks",
23	    STAGE_ROOT / "scripts",
24	    STAGE_ROOT / "skills" / "stage-retrospective",
25	):
26	    if str(import_dir) not in sys.path:
27	        sys.path.insert(0, str(import_dir))
28	
29	from close_work import work_log_reference  # noqa: E402
30	from driver_environment import project_environment  # noqa: E402
31	from lifecycle_paths import v4_lifecycle_paths  # noqa: E402
32	from stage_record_paths import record_path, record_paths  # noqa: E402
33	from stage_work import WorkItem, parse_frontmatter  # noqa: E402
34	
35	CLOSE_WORK = STAGE_ROOT / "skills" / "stage-retrospective" / "close_work.py"
36	ESCALATE_WORK = STAGE_ROOT / "scripts" / "escalate_work.py"
37	AUDIT = STAGE_ROOT / "scripts" / "audit_stage.py"
38	
39	WORK_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^W-[0-9]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*)?$")
40	RETRO_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^R-([0-9]+)$")
41	
42	RETRO_SECTIONS = (
43	    "Work",
44	    "Decision points",
45	    "Principles applied",
46	    "Context that helped",
47	    "Context that was missing",
48	    "Next changes",
49	    "Rule candidate",
50	    "Promotion decision",
51	)
52	
53	
54	def write_driver_retrospective(
55	    stage_root: Path, item: WorkItem
56	) -> tuple[str, str]:
57	    """Write a machine-generated retrospective, flagged driver-generated.
58	
59	    Returns (retro_id, error). The reflective retrospective is deliberately
60	    thin — a human reviews it when merging the run branch (DE-24, mode A).
61	    """
62	
63	    note = "driver-generated (사람 머지 검토 대상)"
64	    # Neutral wording: this is written BEFORE close_work verifies. It must not
65	    # claim success — the item's Verification (stamped by close_work) is the
66	    # source of truth for whether acceptance and the independent review passed.
67	    sections = {
68	        "Work": (
69	            f"{note}: 무인 드라이버가 {item.item_id}의 executor를 실행하고 결과를 커밋했다. "
70	            "acceptance·독립 판정의 실제 통과 여부와 최종 완료는 항목의 Verification"
71	            "(close_work가 기록)이 정본이다. 실행자의 작업 내용·이유·변경 경로 주장은 "
72	            f"`{work_log_reference(item.item_id)}`가 소유한다."
73	        ),
74	        "Decision points": f"{note}: 기계 실행, 별도 결정 없음.",
75	        "Principles applied": f"{note}: Honesty, Fail Fast, No partial completion.",
76	        "Context that helped": f"{note}: 항목 acceptance가 종료를 결정적으로 판정.",
77	        "Context that was missing": f"{note}: 반성적 회고는 사람이 브랜치 머지 시 보완.",
78	        "Next changes": f"{note}: 사람이 격리 브랜치를 검토·머지.",
79	        # A run cannot judge from inside whether its own behavior should bind
80	        # future cards, so it leaves the rule candidate to whoever merges it.
81	        "Rule candidate": f"{note}: 머지하는 사람이 채운다 — 이 실행이 남긴 규칙 후보가 있으면.",
82	        "Promotion decision": (
83	            f"{note}: 항목 Verification의 결과를 따른다(close_work가 acceptance·독립 판정 통과 시에만 completed로 스탬프)."
84	        ),
85	    }
86	
87	    def content_for(retro_id: str) -> str:
88	        body = (
89	            f"---\nid: {retro_id}\nwork_item: {item.item_id}\n---\n\n"
90	            f"# {retro_id} {item.item_id} 무인 드라이버 회고\n"
91	        )
92	        for heading in RETRO_SECTIONS:
93	            body += f"\n## {heading}\n\n{sections[heading]}\n"
94	        return body
95	
96	    try:
97	        retro_id = retrospective_id_for_work_item(
98	            stage_root,
99	            item.item_id,
100	            content_for,
101	        )
102	    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
103	        return "", f"cannot write retrospective for {item.item_id}: {exc}"
104	    return retro_id, ""
105	
106	
107	def current_card_path(stage_root: Path, item_id: str) -> Path:
108	    return record_path(stage_root / v4_lifecycle_paths().current_cards, item_id)
109	
110	
111	def mark_retrospective(stage_root: Path, item_id: str, retro_id: str) -> None:
112	    path = current_card_path(stage_root, item_id)
113	    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
114	    text = set_frontmatter_field(text, "retrospective", "completed")
115	    text = set_frontmatter_field(text, "retrospective_ref", retro_id)
116	    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
117	
118	
119	def close_via_close_work(
120	    project_root: Path,
121	    item_id: str,
122	    extra_checks: list[str],
123	    timeout: int,
124	    promotion_default: str | None = None,
125	) -> tuple[bool, str]:
126	    """Reuse the reviewed close_work.py: acceptance + (autonomous) independent review + close."""
127	
128	    raw_promotion = parse_frontmatter(
129	        current_card_path(project_root / ".stage", item_id)
130	    ).get("promotion", "")
131	    promotion = raw_promotion.strip() if isinstance(raw_promotion, str) else ""
132	    if promotion == "pending" and promotion_default is not None:
133	        promotion = promotion_default
134	    command = [
135	        sys.executable,
136	        str(CLOSE_WORK),
137	        "--project-root",
138	        str(project_root),
139	        item_id,
140	        "--promotion",
141	        promotion,
142	        "--timeout",
143	        str(timeout),
144	    ]
145	    for check in extra_checks:
146	        command += ["--check", check]
147	    try:
148	        proc = subprocess.run(
149	            command,
150	            cwd=str(project_root),
151	            capture_output=True,
152	            text=True,
153	            timeout=timeout + 60,
154	            env=project_environment(project_root),
155	        )
156	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
157	        return False, f"close_work timed out after {timeout + 60}s"
158	    except OSError as exc:
159	        return False, str(exc)
160	    return proc.returncode == 0, (proc.stdout or "") + (proc.stderr or "")
161	
162	
163	def escalate_via_escalate_work(
164	    project_root: Path, item_id: str, reason: str, timeout: int = 120
165	) -> tuple[bool, str]:
166	    """Reuse the reviewed escalate_work.py: item -> blocked + a pending decision."""
167	
168	    command = [
169	        sys.executable,
170	        str(ESCALATE_WORK),
171	        "--project-root",
172	        str(project_root),
173	        item_id,
174	        "--reason",
175	        reason,
176	    ]
177	    try:
178	        proc = subprocess.run(
179	            command, cwd=str(project_root), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout
180	        )
181	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
182	        return False, f"escalate_work timed out after {timeout}s"
183	    except OSError as exc:
184	        return False, str(exc)
185	    return proc.returncode == 0, (proc.stdout or "") + (proc.stderr or "")
186	
187	
188	def shell_command(args: list[str], os_name: str | None = None) -> str:
189	    """Join arguments the way the named platform's shell parses them.
190	
191	    The result is handed to a shell, and the two shells disagree: POSIX shells
192	    strip single quotes, `cmd.exe` does not. Quoting for one breaks the other,
193	    so each gets its own joiner. Windows arguments containing shell
194	    metacharacters must be quoted even when they contain no whitespace.
195	
196	    ``os_name`` defaults to the running platform. It is a parameter so a test can
197	    exercise the other branch without reaching into the process-wide ``os``
198	    module — there is no Windows runner here, so both branches have to be
199	    reachable from any host.
200	    """
201	
202	    if (os_name or os.name) == "nt":
203	        rendered_args: list[str] = []
204	        for arg in args:
205	            rendered = subprocess.list2cmdline([arg])
206	            if any(character in arg for character in "&^|<>") and not (
207	                rendered.startswith('"') and rendered.endswith('"')
208	            ):
209	                trailing_backslashes = len(rendered) - len(rendered.rstrip("\\"))
210	                rendered += "\\" * trailing_backslashes
211	                rendered = f'"{rendered}"'
212	            rendered_args.append(rendered)
213	        return " ".join(rendered_args)
214	    return shlex.join(args)
215	
216	
217	def audit_check(project_root: Path, os_name: str | None = None) -> str:
218	    return shell_command(
219	        [sys.executable, str(AUDIT), "--project-root", str(project_root)], os_name
220	    )
221	
222	
223	def set_frontmatter_field(text: str, name: str, value: str) -> str:
224	    return re.sub(
225	        rf"^({re.escape(name)}:)[ \t]*.*$",
226	        rf"\g<1> {value}",
227	        text,
228	        count=1,
229	        flags=re.MULTILINE,
230	    )
231	
232	
233	def retrospective_id_for_work_item(
234	    stage_root: Path,
235	    item_id: str,
236	    content_for: Callable[[str], str],
237	) -> str:
238	    """Atomically reserve a retrospective, preferring the work item's number."""
239	
240	    if not WORK_ID_RE.fullmatch(item_id):
241	        raise ValueError(f"invalid work item ID for retrospective: {item_id}")
242	
243	    paths = v4_lifecycle_paths()
244	    current_root = stage_root / paths.current_retrospectives
245	    archive_root = stage_root / paths.archive_retrospectives
246	    current_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
247	
248	    numbers: set[int] = set()
249	    owned_ids: list[str] = []
250	    for root in (current_root, archive_root):
251	        for path in record_paths(root, pattern="R-*.md"):
252	            fields = parse_frontmatter(path)
253	            identities = (path.stem, str(fields.get("id", "")))
254	            for identity in identities:
255	                match = RETRO_ID_RE.fullmatch(identity)
256	                if match:
257	                    numbers.add(int(match.group(1)))
258	            record_id = str(fields.get("id", ""))
259	            if (
260	                root == current_root
261	                and fields.get("work_item", "") == item_id
262	                and RETRO_ID_RE.fullmatch(record_id)
263	            ):
264	                owned_ids.append(record_id)
265	
266	    owned_ids = sorted(set(owned_ids))
267	    if len(owned_ids) > 1:
268	        raise RuntimeError(
269	            f"work item {item_id} already owns multiple retrospectives: "
270	            f"{', '.join(owned_ids)}"
271	        )
272	    if owned_ids:
273	        return owned_ids[0]
274	
275	    def reserve(retro_id: str) -> bool:
276	        path = record_path(current_root, retro_id)
277	        try:
278	            with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
279	                handle.write(content_for(retro_id))
280	        except FileExistsError:
281	            return False
282	        return True
283	
284	    preferred_id = f"R-{item_id[2:]}"
285	    preferred_path = record_path(current_root, preferred_id)
286	    preferred_match = RETRO_ID_RE.fullmatch(preferred_id)
287	    preferred_number = int(preferred_match.group(1)) if preferred_match else None
288	    if preferred_path.exists():
289	        owner = str(parse_frontmatter(preferred_path).get("work_item", ""))
290	        if owner == item_id:
291	            return preferred_id
292	        raise RuntimeError(
293	            f"retrospective {preferred_id} is owned by {owner}, not {item_id}"
294	        )
295	    elif preferred_number not in numbers and reserve(preferred_id):
296	        return preferred_id
297	
298	    candidate = (max(numbers) + 1) if numbers else 1
299	    for _ in range(1000):
300	        retro_id = f"R-{candidate:08d}"
301	        if reserve(retro_id):
302	            return retro_id
303	        candidate += 1
304	    raise RuntimeError("could not allocate a free retrospective id")
305	
306	# User note: preserve this audit comment added between sessions.
